versions.content: Perform Inter Module Checks The BSW Module shall perform Inter Module Checks to avoid integration of incompatible files: For every included header file that does not belong to this module, the following Published information elements ( SWS_BSW_00059 ) shall be verified through pre - processor checks:  Major AUTOSAR Release Number (<MIP>_AR_RELEASE_MAJOR_VERSION )  Minor AUTOSAR Release Number ( <MIP>_AR_RELEASE_MINOR_VERSION ) General If the values are not identical to the values expected by the implementation of this module, an error shall be reported.
